title: 1v1 timeout publication recovery across process restarts
behavior: Persisted 30-minute decision timeout is recovered by a fresh Node process.
The terminal revision and exactly one duelFinished event survive repeated restarts before publication ACK.
All physical hands, Decks, Monster/Spell-Trap/Field/Graveyard/Banished/Extra zones remain unchanged.
Both duel-member locks are released; no action receipt or player/economy mutation is created.
A matching markDuelPublished ACK survives another restart and removes the outbox entry; subsequent polling remains empty.
processIsolation: Four child Node processes open the same temporary SQLite database sequentially; parent closes its connection before restart probes.
